name: Tranylcypromine
effects: Irreversible non-selective MAO-A/B inhibitor — reduces treatment-resistant depression and atypical depression
Tyramine dietary restriction MANDATORY — aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods, tap beer, certain wines: hypertensive crisis risk (can be fatal)
Requires 14-day washout before/after other serotonergic drugs to avoid serotonin syndrome
Risk of hypertensive crisis with sympathomimetics, tyramine-rich foods, or indirect sympathomimetics
